name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-06-09, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
